body: Central Arizona Water Conservation District Board of Directors
territoryEvidence: Pima County Resolution 2026-43 levies CAWCD's ad valorem secondary at 0.1000 and its water storage secondary at 0.0400 on the county's full valuation — every parcel in Pima County, 85641 included
reading: 15 directly elected directors, each with their own page under /board/board-members/<slug>/ stating ROLE and COUNTY in the page heading. County split Maricopa 10 / Pima 4 / Pinal 1 matches the board's statutory composition.
robots: https://www.cap-az.com/robots.txt — User-agent: * / Disallow: (empty) — all paths permitted
note: Corrects an earlier read recorded in curated-bodies.ts which had only three confirmed Pima members and said four members' pages state no county. All fifteen pages state a county. The fourth Pima member is Justin Manuel.
